title: Figure 6: Martin Marietta X-24A and X-24B research glider three-view drawings
description: Technical three-view line drawings (front, side and plan views) of two lifting-body research gliders, labeled "Martin Marietta X-24A" and "USAF Modified The X-24B," showing the round fuselage with high-dihedral tails versus the flat-bottomed double-delta X-24B. Caption: "Figure 6. Martin Marietta X-24 A & B Research Gliders. X-24A based on USAF PRIME configuration." Text discusses configurations 6 and 10 and NASA pilot Bill Dana's comments.
